## Summary

This package is PR2802's (mdumitrean, Marius-Paul Dumitrean) construction, unchanged: seven retired-lender aliases (606<-550, 635<-551, 637<-552, 638<-553, 639<-562, 667<-401, 669<-403) and two hostee moves (401->564, 403->565) on PR2751's (tekuuu) twelve-alias words with PR2766's (DavidAriasC) frame refit; its words, owner fill, order and dispatch are PR2802's (local profile {1:2382, 2:648, 3:268, 4:128, 5:26, 8:8}, leftover idle {1:17316, 3:6594, 5:9878, 32:1, 48:26558}). Our contribution is only the finer endpoint certificate (the supplier endpoint certified to 1e-3000 and the fixed-grid-maximum outer kappa C - 1/F - B, as PR2767 did over PR2766) and the integration into our verifier: the construction as one declared patch stage `retired7` with tamper controls, our guards and private-buffer accounting, PR2768's (tekuuu) exact sparse native replay as the default native stage, and a stale-bytecode guard after PR2788 (jeremydiviney). Prepared by Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance. Conditional final kappa = 0.0017177949841186346638272299184281789040…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0017148492247218876758214032268877614551…(2995 digits)). It exceeds PR2802 (exact kappa_decimal from its claim) by 2.29918E-25 only through the finer endpoint grid; the construction gain is PR2802's (exact gate in verify_release.py). grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116; 63 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls.

Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained rows plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, the fixed-grid maximum kappa = C - 1/F - B asserted, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0017177949841186346638272299184281789040…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-(1025/1024)e-3080, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md; fixed-grid maximum of PR2180/PR2161 (dataisfire), outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md; exact-integer coarse exponential PR2168/PR2184 (dataisfire) at the one 3000-digit rejection call).
